summary: Built BM25 inverted index once (term->postings(doc,tf), df/idf, per-doc k1 norm) guarded by sync.Once; per query Rank folds/tokenizes/dedups as before, scores only docs holding a query term in query order with the identical expression, and picks top-10 via a size-10 min-heap with score-desc/ID-asc tiebreak. Safe: index read-only after build, per-call score/seen/touched buffers from sync.Pool (no shared mutable state, no goroutines, race-clean); extra heap is the index (~1-2MB) plus one ~100KB buffer per in-flight call, far under 64MB. Latency: microbench Rank on production query stream 6109465 ns/op -> 2688 ns/op (~2270x, allocs 16010->7); catalog own time per visit is dominated by Rank so declared own_ms drops by ~6ms/visit, well within budget (preview advisory only).
